name: Mayday Memory
source:
Year of 2099, a time where people can buy and sell memories. [Vigil], the PI office that never sleeps, gets a big case! Play as the office's youngest member ""Dell"", who lost her memories and try to solve the case!

The sharp-tongued main character “Dell,”
The superstar with a screw loose “Ain,”
The reckless colleague “Syd,”
The stingy freelancer “Hansol,”
The idiot chief “Jeff,”
And the world's laziest rabbit robot “Mode”!
The kind of weird, and somewhat lacking,
but strangely lovable 6 main characters with explosive chemistry!

To you who will complete our precious memories,
Mayday, Mayday!
translation:
2099年，人们可以买卖记忆的时代。[Vigil]，不夜城PI办公室，获大案！扮演失去记忆的办公室最年轻的成员“戴尔”，努力破案！

言语尖刻的主角“戴尔”，
超级巨星，有着松动的“Ain”，
鲁莽的同事“Syd”
吝啬的自由职业者“韩松”
白痴首领“杰夫”
还有世界上最懒的兔子机器人“Mode”！
那种奇怪，又有些欠缺的，
但奇怪的是可爱的6个主角有着爆炸性的化学反应！

致完成我们珍贵回忆的你，
五月天，五月天！
